text: Possibly. If you're eligible, you'll see an option to change your repayment date in the app when you open your advance details on the Cash screen. Availability depends on your account and the advance, so I can't promise it'll be offered for yours. If you don't see it, message the team through in-app support and they can review your options. It's also a good idea to make sure your account has enough funds by the current due date in case the change isn't approved.
